content: crypto.randomUUID() is a native browser API (Chrome 92+, Firefox 95+, Safari 15.4+) generating RFC4122 v4 UUIDs only, requires a secure context (https/localhost), and is not tree-shakeable-relevant since it's zero-bytes (built into runtime). It does NOT support UUID v7 (time-ordered/sortable) - that requires the 'uuid' npm package or a small dedicated lib like 'uuidv7' (v1.2.1, JS impl of UUIDv7). Recommendation: use native crypto.randomUUID() as the zero-dependency path is tempting but since the brief requires v4 AND v7 with one consistent UI, use the 'uuid' package for both to keep one code path and avoid maintaining two implementations.
